subject: general
question:
**Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

I stare out into the really __amazingly__ dark night.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obviously**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**obviously**" is an antonym of "**amazingly**" because it suggests that something is expected or not surprising.
 
• The adverb "**amazingly**" describes something that is impressive or surprising. (प्रभावशाली या आश्चर्यजनक)
 
 
• **For example- ***Amazingly, the bullet did not penetrate his brain.*
 
 
 
• Marked option "**obviously**" implies that something is clear or evident. (स्पष्ट या प्रत्यक्षतः)
 
 
• **For example- ***She obviously feels that it was important enough to make a stand.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the speaker is looking at a very dark night, which is not surprising or unexpected,
 
• Hence "**obviously**" is a better fit than the other options.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the meaning of the other words.

 
• **Shockingly **means in a way that causes surprise or disbelief, which is not the opposite of "amazingly" in this context. (आश्चर्यजनक)
 
• **Unusually **means in a way that is not common or typical, which is not the opposite of "amazingly" in this context. (असामान्य रूप से)
 
• **Astonishingly **means in a way that causes great surprise or wonder, which is not the opposite of "amazingly" in this context. (आश्चर्यजनक रूप से)
